objective: Prove or refute NP-completeness of the visible-switch decision for a fixed two-repeated-middle corridor family with at most three conditional padding positions per hidden input variable; measure the input and the additional grouping hypotheses.
status: Proved: A uniform family with two repeated middle names and at most three implication placements per shared pad realizes NP-complete strict 3-SAT by varying the visible input alone. The restricted instances use both binary equality and ternary data tests.
title: How little middle-variable sharing can carry a general Boolean formula?
